preconditions.description: Attacker must have the 'authorized' role. This can be achieved by being the contract owner or being authorized by the owner.
The target contract must have a non-zero balance of an ERC20 token to be stolen.

exploit_hint: As an authorized user, call the `setswap(address _tadd, address _rec, uint256 _amt, uint256 _amtd)` function. Set `_tadd` to the address of the ERC20 token held by the contract that you want to steal. Set `_rec` to the attacker's address. Set `_amt` and `_amtd` to 1. This will transfer the entire balance of the specified token from the contract to the attacker's address.
